violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED IN THE FRONT OF THE RESTAURANT: TARO ROOT BUNS, EGG TARTS, AND CUSTARD BUNS ON TPHC WITHOUT BEING MARKED WITH PROPER END TIME. OBSERVED IN HALLWAY: PEKING AND CANTONESE DUCKS ON TPHC WITHOUT MARKED WITH END TIME. OBSERVED ROAST PIG ON TPHC WITHOUT BEING MARKED WITH END TIME.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: FOODS MARKED WITH END TIME DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED FROZEN PORK THAWING ON A SHELF AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: PORK MOVED TO THE COOLER.

violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED MULTIPLE OPEN AND FULL CUPS AND MUGS ON PREP SURFACE NEAR MIXER.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: OPEN CUPS AND MUGS MOVED BY EMPLOYEES TO MORE APPROPRIATE AREA.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE PEELING CARROT WITHOUT GLOVES ON. PIC STATED CARROTS WERE TO BE SERVED WITHOUT COOKING.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. CDI: CARROT THROWN AWAY AND FOOD EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS THEN APPLIED GLOVES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the HANGING DUCK STATION is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. OBSERVED THIS SINK TO BE BLOCKED BY HANGING DUCKS.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: DUCKS MOVED TO THE SIDE SO SINK MAY BE USED.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at HANDWASHING SINK AT THE DUCK STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN, PORK, SHRIMP, AND BEEF STACKED RANDOMLY IN MULTIPLE COOLERS ON TOP OF READY TO EACH FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: EMPLOYEES BEGAN SORTING AND REORGANIZING FOODS AT TIME OF INSPECTION. MARK'S DUCK HOUSE (Inspection Date: 06/30/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN, PORK, SHRIMP, AND BEEF STACKED RANDOMLY IN MULTIPLE COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: EMPLOYEES BEGAN SORTING AND REORGANIZING FOOD AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED TWO LARGE CONTAINERS OF ROAST PORK ON THE COUNTER ADJACENT TO THE MIXING AREA. PORK AT ~66.2F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PORK MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER. CEASE HOLDING FOODS AT ROOM TEMPERATURE UNTIL YOU ARE READY TO USE THEM FOR COOKING. RETRAIN EMPLOYEES.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): DUCK (COOKED AND RAW), CHICKEN (COOKED AND RAW), ROAST PORK, EGG CUSTARD BAKERY ITEMS
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. CDI: EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH DOCUMENTATION AND AGREEMENT AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: PLACING DEEP FULL CONTAINERS OF FOODS IN THE COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. EHS ADVISED PURCHASING AN ICE WAND FOR BROTHS AND SEPARATING SOLID FOODS IN SHALLOW PANS BEFORE PLACING IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: THREE-DOOR PREP TOP COOLER NEAR COOKLINE
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: ALL SPICES AND LIQUIDS AT THE COOKING/WOK STATIONS
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS IN DRY STORAGE AREA AND CHEWING SIGNS ON PLASTIC BAG.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PEST CONTROL SERVICE MUST COME WITHIN TEN DAYS. SEND EHS A COPY OF THE INVOICE.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window or door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means. OBSERVED BACK DOOR IN KITCHEN TO BE OPEN DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. INSTALL A SCREEN DOOR OR AIR CURTAIN OR KEEP THIS DOOR SHUT WHILE NOT BEING DIRECTLY USED.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. OBSERVED CONSIDERABLE BUILD-UP AND STACKED ITEMS IN HOT WATER HEATER ROOM. ROOM IS SO FULL IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO ENTER.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. CLEAN THIS ROOM SO THAT IT IS CLEAN AND DOES NOT PROVIDE HARBORAGE FOR PESTS.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Laundered
violations.observation: Wiping cloths improperly stored between use, not in chemical sanitizing solution, in the following locations: OBSERVED DIRTY WIPING CLOTHS ON THE FLOOR ON THE WOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths in use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be laundered daily.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED RICE SCOOP STORED IN ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER AT THE BACK RICE WARMER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: WATER DUMPED AND SCOOP RAN THROUGH DISHMACHINE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: OBSERVED CUTTING BOARD IN THE BACK THAT are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. CDI: CUTTING BOARD THROWN AWAY AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Maintained Clean
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE EMPLOYEE BATHROOM IN THE BACK OF THE KITCHEN WITH A FOUL ODOR AND IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. MARK'S DUCK HOUSE (Inspection Date: 06/30/2025) Page 4 of 5

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE ENTIRE FACILITY TO NEED A HIGH FREQUENCY OF CLEANING. A SOUR ODOR IS PRESENT THROUGHOUT THE KITCHEN AND WATER FROM RAW FOODS SITS ON THE FLOOR FOR PERIODS OF TIME. GRIME AND DEBRIS IS BUILT UP AROUND COOKING LINES AND COOLERS AND IN THE ROOMS IN THE BACK OF THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
